forecasts.question: Will the Knesset pass the dissolution bill's final reading with a fixed election date earlier than 2026-10-27 before EOD 2026-07-15?
forecasts.delta_reason: Reduced 0.45 → 0.25. Two structural problems: (1) The dissolution bill currently specifies election date as a range (Sep 8 – Oct 20), NOT a fixed date — per F6's ambiguity_rule ('passage that leaves the date to a later committee or sets only a band without a fixed date = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO'), passage with a date band only resolves AMBIGUOUS-AS-NO, meaning F6 YES requires both final reading passage AND a legislatively fixed specific date, a higher bar than previously priced. (2) ToI reports election likely stays Oct 27; no final readings scheduled; coalition source says bill 'unlikely to pass' final readings before July 15 horizon; Netanyahu-Smotrich set aside haredi draft issue, reducing dissolution pressure that was the primary driver of the 106-0 first reading.
